title: Group Relative Policy Optimisation Improves Multilingual Speech Recognition in Low-Resource Languages
abstract: arXiv:2610.30663v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autoregressive encoder-decoder speech recognition models trained with teacher forcing can suffer from exposure bias, limiting their ability to recover from their own prediction errors at inference time. Recent work has shown that reinforcement learning with Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) improves speech recognition in major languages with LLM-based models. We extend this line of work to smaller, non-LLM encoder-decoder ASR models, using Whisper-large-v3 as a case study across 51 African languages. The benefits of this approach are most pronounced when training data is scarce or when input audio is noisy or degraded. Our resulting model, SunflowerASR, achieves the best published macro-averaged WER on the AfriVox-v2 (0.227) and SimbaBench (0.372) benchmarks, and is publicly available.

translated_title: 组相对策略优化提升低资源语言的多语言语音识别
translated_abstract: 采用教师强迫（teacher forcing）训练的自回归编码器-解码器语音识别模型可能存在曝光偏差（exposure bias），限制了模型在推理时从自身预测错误中恢复的能力。近期研究表明，使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）的强化学习能够提升基于大语言模型（LLM）的模型在主要语言上的语音识别性能。我们将这一研究方向扩展到更小的、非LLM的编码器-解码器ASR模型，以Whisper-large-v3为案例，覆盖51种非洲语言。当训练数据稀缺或输入音频嘈杂、质量退化时，该方法的优势最为显著。我们得到的模型SunflowerASR在AfriVox-v2（0.227）和SimbaBench（0.372）基准测试上取得了已发表的最佳宏平均词错误率（WER），并已公开发布。
tldr: 将组相对策略优化（GRPO）强化学习应用于非LLM的Whisper编码器-解码器模型，训练出的SunflowerASR在51种非洲低资源语言上取得已发表的最佳词错误率，尤其在训练数据稀缺或音频嘈杂的场景下优势最为明显。
en_tdlr: Applying Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) reinforcement learning to the non-LLM Whisper encoder-decoder model yields SunflowerASR, which achieves the best published WER across 51 low-resource African languages, with the greatest gains when training data is scarce or audio is noisy.
